terms.gloss: take away; use up, consume; destroy, carry off, kill
evidence: Cic. Tusc. 2.20: sīc corpus clāde horribilī absūmptum extābuit (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: imber nive mixtus et intoleranda vīs frīgoris et hominēs multōs et jūmenta et elephantōs prope omnēs absūmpsit
phrases.english: rain mixed with snow and unbearable cold carried off many men and beasts of burden and almost all the elephants
